item.title: Aperiodic Tilings V: the Refinable Frontier
item.description: A sequel to my previous posts on finite-state transducers for aperiodic tilings: if you have a tiling you can’t build a transducer for, here’s an algorithm to turn it into one you can.

item.title: Brute-forcing Langley’s geometry problem with field extensions
item.description: An application of algebraic extensions of the rationals: cheating (arguably) at elementary geometry puzzles.

item.title: In which I have Opinions about parsing and grammars
item.description: A collection of semi-connected rants about context-free grammars, parser generators, and the ways in which they aren’t quite as useful as I’d like them to be.

item.title: Policy of transience
item.description: A description of some of my personal computing habits, focusing on avoiding things ‘just turning out’ to last for ever in a disorganised manner.

item.title: Iconography of the PuTTY tools
item.description: A PuTTY user asked about the history of its logo and icon collection. I discuss the design intentions and technical aspects.

item.title: Git without a forge
item.description: My personal projects are in Git, but not on a ‘forge’ style website. I talk about why, and how to interact with them.

item.title: XOR
item.description: An introduction to the boolean and bitwise XOR operators, their uses, and some advanced topics they lead in to.

item.title: Post-quantum public-key encryption: what’s it all about?
item.description: An explanation of some post-quantum public-key cryptosystems, simplified to the level of pop-science.

item.title: Separation of concerns in a bug tracker
item.description: A design thought about how bug trackers could use a more accurate data representation to make queries easier.

item.title: Possibly all the ways to get loop-finding in graphs wrong
item.description: The history of all the mistakes I've made trying to detect loops in graphs while writing my puzzle collection.

item.title: Code review antipatterns
item.description: A taxonomy of frustrating code review behaviours, and some thoughts about them.

item.title: Symbiosisware
item.description: A definition and discussion of my term “symbiosisware”, describing software consciously designed for only yourself to use.

item.title: Beyond “Beyond the wall”
item.description: A sequel to last month's post on finite-state transducers for aperiodic tilings.

item.title: Beyond the wall: working with aperiodic tilings using finite-state transducers
item.description: A sequel to last year's two posts on combinatorial coordinates, this time applying regular-language theory to them.

item.title: Writing commit messages
item.description: (Yet another) guide to writing commit messages in version control, with a focus on what facts and rationale are good things to include.

item.title: I hate bubblesort
item.description: A short opinion: bubblesort is an awful sorting algorithm and I wish people would stop teaching it.

item.title: Stop helping!
item.description: A short opinion: command-line tools shouldn’t print long help text as well as an error message.

item.title: Philosophy of coroutines
item.description: Some thoughts about coroutines in general, why I like them so much, and ways of using them and thinking about them.

item.title: Writing custom C++20 coroutine systems
item.description: A detailed introduction to the C++20 coroutine system, written in the course of teaching myself about it.

item.title: Workarounds for C11 _Generic
item.description: A description of the big design limitation of C11's _Generic feature, and various workarounds, mostly involving using more instances of _Generic to patch up the original one.

item.title: How to read error messages
item.description: An article about getting the most out of error messages, particularly OS and network errors. Adapted from a talk I gave to colleagues last year.

item.title: Combinatorial coordinates for the aperiodic Spectre tiling
item.description: A description of the algorithms for generating the Spectre tiling in my puzzle game Loopy.

item.title: Two algorithms for randomly generating aperiodic tilings
item.description: A description of the algorithms for generating Penrose and Hat tilings in my puzzle game Loopy.

item.title: Implementing OpenSSH certificate support in PuTTY
item.description: A retrospective of the development of the headline new feature in PuTTY 0.78: OpenSSH-style certificates on host and user keys.

item.title: History of PuTTY's development
item.description: An overview of PuTTY's development from its genesis in 1996 to the state of affairs in 2020. Written in response to an email query.

item.title: Writing a soluble-grid generator for Mines
item.description: A description of the technique for generating guaranteed-soluble Minesweeper grids in my puzzle game Mines. Written in response to an email query.

item.title: Writing a solver for Net
item.description: A description of the automated solver in my puzzle game Net. Written in response to an email query.

item.title: Porting PuTTY to Windows on Arm
item.description: What I had to do to make PuTTY compile for Windows on Arm as well as on x86, plus a deep dive into the NEON-accelerated cryptography.
